workspaceHelp: Select a file from configured locations. Browser files are not uploaded.
searchRootsPlaceholder: Search, or type a path like data/train.npz
emptyDirectory: This directory has no selectable entries.
browseSafety: Only folders the daemon is allowed to read are shown.
chooseFile: Choose a file, not a directory.
headerHelp: Metadata only, separate from numerical previews. Shapes below exclude the sample dimension; file size is not reported by this endpoint.
inspectionDetails: Dataset inspection refused or unavailable. Reconnect, select a supported dataset again, or retry its header inspection.
chooseDataset: Choose a dataset from the verified daemon.
inspectionReconnect: Reconnect and select this dataset again to inspect its header.
previewStopped: Preview loading stopped. Refresh preview to retry.
selectDataset: Select a dataset file from the connected daemon.
previewReconnect: Reconnect and select this dataset again to preview.
previewNotFull: This is not a full-dataset analysis.
correlationMissing: Correlation requires at least two output features.
correlationInsufficientRows: Correlation requires at least two sampled rows.
featureOrder: Feature order: {features}. Missing coefficients remain gray.
pngExportUnavailable: PNG export is unavailable until the chart is ready.
pngExportPreparationFailed: PNG export could not be prepared. Retry the export.
pngExportRequested: PNG export requested. Your browser controls where it is saved; this is the bounded preview.
pngExportRequestFailed: PNG export could not be requested. Check your browser download settings and retry.
plotHelp: Drag to zoom; Shift-drag to pan; double-click to reset. Export is this preview, not the dataset.
heatmapHelp: Wheel or +/- to zoom; drag or arrow keys to pan; 0 to reset. Gray cells are missing values.
statsCaption: Input statistics over bounded sampled rows
